reviews.text: I really like this peeling gel from Anua. It feels gentle on the skin but still gives a nice exfoliating effect. My skin feels smoother, softer, and cleaner after using it. It’s easy to use and doesn’t leave my skin feeling overly dry. Overall, a great addition to my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 Anua 呢款去角質凝膠。塗喺皮膚上好溫和，但仍然有好好嘅去角質效果。用咗之後皮膚感覺更加幼滑、柔軟、清爽。易用，而且唔會令皮膚感覺太乾。總括嚟講，係我護膚程序中一個好好嘅新增產品！

reviews.text: cleanses my pores. keeps my face soft and smooth. noticed my skin lighter and softer after 4 weeks. blackhead and whiteheads have minimized with consistent use. skin is sensitive; therefore, no breakouts. have been using this cleanser exfoliant religiously for years now.
reviews.zh: 清潔毛孔。令面部柔軟、幼滑。用咗四個星期之後，我留意到皮膚更加亮白、更加柔軟。持續使用之後，黑頭同白頭都減少咗。我皮膚敏感，所以冇爆痘。我用呢款潔面去角質產品已經好多年，一直都堅持咁用。

reviews.text: I recently started using the Anua Heartleaf LHA Moisture Peeling Gel, and I’m loving how gentle yet effective it feels on my skin. It helps remove dead skin cells and impurities while leaving my skin smooth, refreshed, and hydrated without any dryness or irritation. My complexion feels softer, clearer, and more balanced after each use. A great exfoliator for a healthy, glowing skin routine!
reviews.zh: 我最近開始用 Anua Heartleaf LHA Moisture Peeling Gel，好鍾意佢溫和但又有效嘅感覺。佢可以去除死皮同污垢，令皮膚幼滑、清爽、水潤，冇乾燥或者刺激感。每次用完，膚質都感覺更加柔軟、清透、平衡。係一款好好嘅去角質產品，可以令護膚程序更健康、更有光澤！

reviews.text: Anua Heartleaf LHA Moisture Peeling Gel gently exfoliates while keeping my skin feeling hydrated and comfortable. It removes dead skin cells without causing irritation, leaving my complexion smoother, softer, and more refreshed. It's a great addition to my routine when I want gentle exfoliation with a boost of moisture.
reviews.zh: Anua Heartleaf LHA Moisture Peeling Gel 溫和地去角質，同時令皮膚保持水潤、舒適。佢可以去除死皮，又唔會引起刺激，令膚質更加平滑、柔軟、清爽。當我想溫和去角質，同時補充水分嗰時，佢就係我護膚程序中好好嘅選擇。

reviews.text: Mild exfoliating gel with soft rolling texture on skin. Removes dead skin buildup from surface without harsh scrubbing feeling. Skin feels smoother after rinse. Works well once or twice a week as part of skincare routine. Leaves fresh and clean feel after use. Suitable for skin needing gentle exfoliation.
reviews.zh: 溫和去角質凝膠，質地柔軟，塗開時有滾動感。可以去除表面堆積嘅死皮，唔會有粗暴磨擦嘅感覺。沖洗之後皮膚更加平滑。作為護膚程序一部分，每星期用一至兩次效果好好。用完之後感覺清新、乾淨。適合需要溫和去角質嘅皮膚。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this product for a few weeks now, and honestly, I didn’t expect much at first—but it surprised me. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy. I noticed my skin feels softer and more hydrated, especially in the morning.
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款產品幾個星期，老實講，一開始我冇咩期望，但係佢令我好驚喜。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會令皮膚油膩。我留意到皮膚感覺更加柔軟、更加水潤，尤其係朝早。

reviews.text: This peeling gel is very gentle yet effective. My skin feels smoother and fresher after using it, without any irritation. I really like the texture and the way it applies. The scent is also pleasant, not too strong. It’s a product I’m definitely happy to have in my routine.
reviews.zh: 呢款去角質凝膠好溫和但又有效。用咗之後皮膚感覺更加平滑、清新，冇任何刺激。我好鍾意佢嘅質地同塗開嘅感覺。香味都好舒服，唔會太濃。呢款產品我絕對好樂意放喺我嘅護膚程序入面。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
